edition.notes: The page's headnote states that the letter was published on the German site of the Society of Saint Pius X on 10 July 2000 and translated from German by a French traditionalist bulletin on 12 July. Its title-line gives 26 June and its text 29 June; the recourse lodged on 13 July 2000 cites 29 June. The same page and German text are cited in Prawo Kanoniczne 69/1 (2026) 179 n. 23.

passages.context: The German original and the Italian and French renderings were read: the refusal to make the February 2000 compromise a special law, the reasoning on the priest's retained right to the Missal of 1970, the statement that a limitation of its exercise can never become the general rule in an institute or be imposed on seminarians, the limitation of the superior general's office to two consecutive six-year terms, the direct appointment of Father Arnaud Devillers, and the requirement of new seminary rectors.

work.author: Pontifical Commission Ecclesia Dei
work.description: The letter of Cardinal Dario Castrillon Hoyos of 29 June 2000, read to the Fraternity's general chapter at Wigratzbad by Monsignor Camille Perl, refusing to approve the February 2000 compromise as a special law on the ground that a priest enjoying the privilege of the 1962 Missal does not lose the right to use the Missal of 1970 and that no superior below the Supreme Pontiff may prevent him from following the general law; limiting the office of superior general to two consecutive six-year terms; appointing Father Arnaud Devillers superior general for six years; and requiring new rectors for both seminaries. Not published by the Holy See.
work.title: Letter of the Pontifical Commission Ecclesia Dei to the general chapter of the Priestly Fraternity of Saint Peter, Prot. N. 748/2000 (29 June 2000)
